headline: STL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 4.39 at OAK 3.44, with a projected total of 7.83. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: STL moved -0.62 runs while OAK moved -1.05, changing the projected margin by +0.43 runs. The projected total fell -1.67, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: J.T. Ginn has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Jacob Wilson, Iván Herrera, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Pedro Pagés because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
